historical_record.description: The twelve-room Bergerot Primary School, later renamed the Rochambeau School, was finished on this block, designed by Emil Lemme; McKillop Bros. built it for $37,000, and McSheehy Bros. finished its basement and yards under a second contract completed on June 19, 1908.
